INVALID_SESSION_REFERENCES.zh: 请选择至多 5 个不同的会话
INVALID_SESSION_REFERENCES.en: Choose at most five different conversations

SESSION_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 会话引用暂时无法读取

SESSION_REFERENCE_TOO_LARGE.zh: 会话历史过大，请移除此引用后发送
SESSION_REFERENCE_TOO_LARGE.en: The session history is too large; remove this reference to send

SESSION_REFERENCE_TIMEOUT.zh: 读取会话超时，请重试原请求
SESSION_REFERENCE_TIMEOUT.en: Reading the session timed out; retry the original request

SESSION_REFERENCES_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 当前客户端或 Agent 不支持会话引用
SESSION_REFERENCES_UNSUPPORTED.en: This client or agent does not support session references
